name: Sounds of the Night
source:
You are somehow stuck in the forest in the middle of the night, then you meet a fox girl and you need to help her rescue the tsukihime, and try to escape!

[Edited from [url=https://kawaiikitsunelover645.itch.io/sounds-of-the-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不知为何，你深夜被困在森林里，随后遇见一名狐娘。你需要帮助她营救月姬，并设法逃离！

（改编自[url=https://kawaiikitsunelover645.itch.io/sounds-of-the-night]itch.io[/url]）
